literal_meaning: জিগর বা হৃদয় ছিদ্রকারী (liver or heart-piercing)
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই দুর্ঘটনার খবর শুনে সকলের মন জিগরপস্তানী হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: Hearing the news of the accident left everyone's heart heartbroken.
The tune of his song was heart-rending.
history: This idiom is referenced in Kazi Nazrul Islam's song with the line 'এ কোন জিগর পস্তানী সুর', highlighting its literary origin in Bengali revolutionary poetry.
note: Primarily used in literary contexts due to its association with Nazrul's works.
